verdict_reason: Solid behavioural suite through the real macro with only fetch mocked, but one title over-claims, set-up is copied across tests, and several new fallback/guard branches are unproven.

todos.issue: Title 'Should run the search when Search is pressed, without leaving the page' claims no native submission, but the test asserts only the posted q and the announcement (lines 171-176). Deleting event.preventDefault() at multi-select-search.js:148 leaves it green, because jsdom does not navigate on a native submit. The Remove test (line 147-163) proves the same claim with a navigated spy; this one does not.
todos.fix: Must: the test asserts that pressing Search causes no native form submission, or its title stops claiming it. One way: capture native submits with the same listener the Remove test uses and assert none happened.

todos.issue: Test set-up is copied between tests instead of living in a file-level helper beside mount(): the 'capture submits nobody prevented' listener is written four times (lines 147, 214, 239, 301), the dropdown() lookup twice (lines 261, 281), and the held-fetch deferred-promise pattern twice (lines 186, 234).
todos.fix: Must: each piece of set-up has one helper in the file that every test calls, with no local copies left. One way: add nativeSubmitsOf(form) returning the array it records, dropdownOf(results), and a heldResponse() returning { promise, answer }, then call them from each test.

todos.issue: New fallback and guard branches in multi-select-search.js have no test that fails without them: an OK response with no [data-multi-select-search-results] region (resultsIn returns null, line 15/21) must fall back to a native submit; a rejected fetch (lines 22-23 / 89) must too; a click on the already-focused search box re-shows the dropdown after Escape (line 185); and the constructor must leave the page alone when a part is missing, e.g. no enclosing form (partsOf line 46). Deleting line 185 or the every(Boolean) guard leaves the suite green; without the guard a macro used outside a form throws on form.addEventListener.
todos.fix: Must: each of these branches has a test that turns red when the branch is removed. One way: add a test where fetch resolves ok with HTML lacking the results region and assert the native submitter; one where fetch rejects; one pressing Escape then clicking the box; and one mounting without a <form> and asserting no enhanced class and no error.
